why: 3.0.0 may publish only when master is green end to end: make check, the playground and the example apps. The owner's go is requested from that evidence; nothing here publishes.
what: Run the GA checks on master and record their output in docs/v3/verdicts/ga-checks.md. No code change, no release config change (master's .releaserc.json is already `branches: ["master"]`).
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md section 4.5. GA checks are `make check` on master, the playground build and the example apps. No consumer repo is a precondition. The `basalt.sibling` key created by v3-cli-sibling stays: argo and shutterflow need a second install after 3.0.0 is published; it is removed by the held cutover re-cut.
exemplar: scripts/release.test.ts gate table for the wording of the reason.
change: On a clean origin/master worktree: (1) `make check` (build, pre, layout, pack-test). (2) `bun --filter @basalt-ui/playground build`. (3) For each directory under examples/ that declares `basalt-ui`: `bun install` and `bun run build` there, listing the result. examples/react is pre-v3 and outside the workspace globs today; if it cannot build against the v3 package, say so in the page and in the owner's go request and leave it out of the green claim, not silently. (4) Write docs/v3/verdicts/ga-checks.md with the commit sha, the commands, their exit codes and any example left out. Nothing is published. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none.
commits: One docs: commit for the page; conventional, empty scope, no attribution; rebase-merge.
proof: ga-checks.md with sha and exit codes.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 on the recorded sha, the playground build exits 0, and every examples/* that declares basalt-ui is either green or named as left out with the reason (ga-checks.md)
`rg -n "@mantine" packages/basalt-ui/src` returns nothing and tests/required-peers.test.ts asserts an empty required-peer set
out_of_scope: Running make release, npm deprecate or any publish, editing the version gate, removing basalt.sibling, consumer repos, deleting tools/migrate-v3.
post_merge: Orchestrator, on a clean master: `GA=1 make release-dry` prints 3.0.0, and without GA=1 the gate refuses it. Then ask the owner for the first publish; the go is his (v3-ga).
